Vault Hunters, meet CL4P-TP. 🤖 Despite everyone's favorite @borderlands robot being made of metal, this Claptrap wall art is actually made of wood.  Every piece was hand cut on a scroll saw, then shaped, painted, and weathered until it looked like he'd survived a few too many trips through Pandora. Then I added a few extra details that took it over the top: - His eye is real glass - Real wires hanging loose, just like the real him - Real screws set right into the piece - Bandages made from ripped and grunged fabric - A stenciled warning screen with a gloss finish He is now available on my website. Let me know in the comments if you'd like the direct link!  Now for some fun...
